plugin_music_description: Plays NetEase Cloud Music: search, daily picks, liked songs, personal FM and your playlists, played by Kotone itself; music ducks while she speaks
plugin_music_daily_desc: Songs picked for your taste: {count}, updated daily
plugin_music_fm_desc: One song after another; like the ones you love
plugin_music_login_title: Log in to NetEase Cloud Music
plugin_music_login_desc: The button opens NetEase Cloud Music's own login page; scan it with the NetEase Cloud Music app. Once you're logged in you can play full songs, daily picks and your playlists (without logging in, most songs are 30-second previews).
plugin_music_login_waiting: Scan the code in the NetEase Cloud Music window that opened (use the NetEase Cloud Music app)
plugin_music_login_expired: The login window closed after waiting too long. Click to open it again
plugin_music_login_failed_unknown: Couldn't log in. Get a new code and try again
plugin_music_login_needed: She wants to play music: log in to NetEase Cloud Music first (only once)
plugin_music_login_button: Log in to NetEase Cloud Music
plugin_music_login_privacy: You log in on NetEase Cloud Music's own page; Kotone only keeps the login (kept by Windows) and uses it for music only.
plugin_music_logged_out_hint: Log in once before the first song; after that she can play and skip songs for you in a call too.
plugin_music_need_login: Log in to NetEase Cloud Music first
plugin_music_logged_out: Logged out of NetEase Cloud Music
plugin_music_off_note: Turn it on and she can play NetEase Cloud Music (search, daily picks, liked songs, personal FM, your playlists); what is playing also shows in the left sidebar.
plugin_music_push_login_when: Your NetEase Cloud Music login expired (you logged in before and NetEase asks you to log in again)
plugin_music_push_login_what: Posts a card with a “Log in to NetEase Cloud Music” button (opens NetEase's official login page; scan with the NetEase Cloud Music app); once you're in, the card turns into “Logged in” in place
plugin_music_card_expired: Your NetEase Cloud Music login expired: log in again to play full songs, daily picks and your playlists.
plugin_music_card_done: Logged in to NetEase Cloud Music
plugin_music_card_done_named: Logged in to NetEase Cloud Music: {nickname}
plugin_music_card_empty: NetEase Cloud Music pushes in the chat open here.
